name: FileUploaderItem

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether file uploader item is disabled

props.name: errorBody
props.description: Error message body for an invalid file upload

props.name: errorSubject
props.description: Error message subject for an invalid file upload

props.name: iconDescription
props.description: Description of status icon (displayed in native tooltip)

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify if the currently uploaded file is invalid

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the FileUploaderButton, from a list of available sizes.

props.name: uuid
props.description: Unique identifier for the file object

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon FileUploaderItem rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
